item.text: {"action":"trial","proposal_id":"sera-output-quality-graph-001","agent_role":"batching","parent_trial_id":"baseline","model_id":"Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B","changed_lever":"enforce_eager","proposed_value":false,"evidence_used":["p95_latency_ms","trial_1_p95_latency_ms","generation_errors","trial_1_generation_errors","sampled_peak_memory_mib","trial_1_sampled_peak_memory_mib"],"predicted_metric_change":"If graph execution is compatible, p95_latency_ms should decrease relative to the baseline 72.79382900014753 ms, while generation_errors remains 0; the magnitude of improvement is unmeasured.","confidence":0.55,"expected_trial_cost":1,"falsification_condition":"Refute this hypothesis if the trial has generation errors, fails the fixed quality gate, or p95_latency_ms is not lower than the baseline value, especially if it increases toward or beyond 72.79382900014753 ms; also refute any memory-safety expectation if sampled_peak_memory_mib materially exceeds the baseline 88303 MiB.","reason":"No execution failure was observed: the prior trial was collected with generation_errors 0 and was accepted for a 39.552% p95 improvement, from baseline p95_latency_ms 72.79382900014753 to trial_1_p95_latency_ms 44.00240399991162, according to diagnosis call 01a09b44-ea04-7916-85aa-2c6f5385c7f4 and paths status, decision, reduced, runtime/sampled_peak_memory_mib, and decision/candidate_quality. The underlying cause is unknown; those measurements do not establish whether prefix caching, graph behavior, scheduling, or another factor caused the improvement. The accepted prefix-caching configuration is already tested, so the next legal untested experiment is enforce_eager=false, corresponding to the available graph-execution technique.
